instructions: For every finding, classify semantic equivalence against one gold finding as hit or false_positive. For hits, mark evidence_accuracy accurate or inaccurate. Each gold finding can match at most one finding per review set.

gold_findings.reason: retry_limit has no upper bound, so arbitrarily oversized nonnegative integers are emitted in a simulated policy record despite the stated rejection of oversized numeric guard values.

findings.message: evidence_class: behavioral_direct | evidence: `delegation_shadow`가 dict가 아니면 validator를 호출하지 않고 결과에서 조용히 누락된다. malformed shadow 요청도 rejection record로 남긴다는 변경 의도와 달리 관찰 가능한 기록이 생성되지 않는다. 비-dict 입력도 `delegation_shadow` rejection record로 정규화하도록 수정 필요.

gold_findings.reason: The tooltip label now directly uses rejectionReason without a fallback, allowing missing or empty rejection reasons to produce an unusable blank tooltip.
classify_policy_comparison can return hit for balanced or cost_saver when cost_delta is missing, falsely treating an unmeasured cost outcome as validated.
